verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Qad sami'a Allaahu qawlal-latee tujaadiluka fee zawjihaa wa tashtakee ilaa Allaahi Wallaahu yasma'u tahaawurakumaa innallaaha samee'un baseer
Al-ladheena yuzaahiroona minkum min nisaa'ihim maa hunna ummahaatihim in ummahaatuhum illal-laa'ee waladnahum wa innahum layaqooloona munkaran minal-qawli wa zooran wa innallaaha la-afuwwun ghafoor
Wal-ladheena yuzaahiroona min nisaa'ihim thumma ya'oodoona limaa qaaloo fatahreeru raqabatin min qabli an yatamaassaa dhaalikum too'azoona bihi Wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona khabeer

Faman lam yajid fasiyaamu shahrayni mutataabi'ayni min qabli an yatamaassaa faman lam yastati fa-it'aamu sitteena miskeenan dhaalika litu'minoo Billaahi wa rasoolihi wa tilka hudoodu Allaahi wa lilkaafireena adhaabun aleem
Innal-ladheena yuhaaddoona Allaaha wa rasoolahu kubitoo kamaa kubital-ladheena min qablihim wa qad anzalnaa aayaatin bayyinaatin wa lilkaafireena adhaabun muheen
Yawma yab'athuhumu Allaahu jamee'an fayunabbi'uhum bimaa amiloo ahsaahu Allaahu wa nasoohu Wallaahu alaa kulli shay'in shaheed

Alam taraa annallaaha ya'lamu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi maa yakoonu min najwaa thalaathatin illaa huwa raabi'uhum wa laa khamsatin illaa huwa saadisuhum wa laa adnaa min dhaalika wa laa akthara illaa huwa ma'ahum ayna maa kaanoo thumma yunabbi'uhum bimaa amiloo yawmal-qiyaamati innallaaha bikulli shay'in aleem

Alam taraa ilal-ladheena nuhoo anin-najwaa thumma ya'oodoona limaa nuhoo anhu wa yatanaajawna bil-ithmi wal-udwaani wa ma'siyatir-rasooli wa idhaa jaa'ooka hayyawka bimaa lam yuhayyika bihi Allaahu wa yaqooloona fee anfusihim lawlaa yu'adhdhibunaa Allaahu bimaa naqoolu hasbuhum jahannamu yaslawnahaa fabi'sal-maseer
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa tanaajaytum falaa tatanaajaw bil-ithmi wal-udwaani wa ma'siyatir-rasooli wa tanaajaw bil-birri wat-taqwaa wattaqoo Allaahal-ladhee ilayhi tuhsharoon
Innaman-najwaa minash-shaytaani liyahzunal-ladheena aamanoo wa laysa bidaarrihim shay'an illaa bi-idhni Allaahi wa alaa Allaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa qeela lakum tafassahoo fil-majaalisi fafsahoo yafsahi Allaahu lakum wa idhaa qeelan-shuzoo fanshuzoo yarfa'i Allaahul-ladheena aamanoo minkum wal-ladheena ootul-ilma darajaatin Wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona khabeer
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa naajaytumur-rasoola faqaddimoo bayna yaday najwaakum sadaqatan dhaalika khayrun lakum wa atharu fa-in lam tajidoo fa-innallaaha ghafoorun Raheem

A'ashfaqtum an tuqaddimoo bayna yaday najwaakum sadaqaatin fa-idh lam taf'aloo wa taaba Allaahu alaykum fa-aqeemus-salaata wa aatuz-zakaata wa atee'oo Allaaha wa rasoolahu Wallaahu khabeerun bimaa ta'maloon
Alam taraa ilal-ladheena tawallaw qawman ghadiba Allaahu alayhim maa hum minkum wa laa minhum wa yahlifoona alal-kadhibi wa hum ya'lamoon
A'adda Allaahu lahum adhaaban shadeedan innahum saa'a maa kaanoo ya'maloon
Ittakhadhoo aymaanahum junnatan fasaddoo an sabeelillaahi falahum adhaabun muheen
Lan tughniya anhum amwaaluhum wa laa awlaaduhum mina Allaahi shay'an ulaa'ika ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaalidoon
Yawma yab'athuhumu Allaahu jamee'an fayahlifoona lahu kamaa yahlifoona lakum wa yahsaboona annahum alaa shay'in alaa innahum humul-kaadhiboon
Istahwadha alayhimush-shaytaanu fa-ansaahum dhikra Allaahi ulaa'ika hizbush-shaytaani alaa inna hizbash-shaytaani humul-khaasiroon
Innal-ladheena yuhaaddoona Allaaha wa rasoolahu ulaa'ika fil-adhalleen
Kataba Allaahu la-aghlibanna anaa wa rusulee innallaaha qawiyyun azeez

Laa tajidu qawman yu'minoona Billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri yuwaaddoona man haadda Allaaha wa rasoolahu wa law kaanoo aabaa'ahum aw abnaa'ahum aw ikhwaanahum aw asheeratahum ulaa'ika kataba fee quloobihimul-eemaana wa ayyadahum biroohin minhu wa yudkhiluhum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa radiya Allaahu anhum wa radoo anhu ulaa'ika hizbu Allaahi alaa inna hizba Allaahi humul-muflihoon
